scenario.summary: Selects every shipping option priced above $0.00 from the estimate and verifies the order total equals sub-total plus the shipping price plus handling.
steps: For each shipping option priced above $0.00: select it and verify order total = sub-total + shipping + handling
assertions: Order total equals sub-total + shipping price + handling charges for each paid option
evidence: The method checks only the estimate options priced above $0.00 and reads no data value; with no such option it asserts nothing. No precondition need (decision 2026-11-04 after a baseline run: the migrated test behaves exactly as today).

Baseline 2026-11-04 (origin/dev, original sheet, atstage): FreeShippingCost PASS; PaidShippingCost FAILS on the order total (e.g. page $29.00 vs expected $39.00), a pre-existing page/framework calculation issue, not data.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
